scope: Necessary rejection of the completed per-ideal absolute spectral comparison; conditional ramified-dyadic moment-to-coarse-jet formula. No actual Shimura differential evaluation.

sources.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions, Gamma recurrence
sources.use: Specialize D98's completed multiplier at mu=1, obtaining 8*pi/N*K1(Z0*N).

sources.title: Paul D. Nelson, Evaluating modular forms on Shimura curves
sources.use: Background for the existing implemented Shimizu method. D91--D98 supply the project's degree-eight adaptation; this paper is not a new tail certificate.

sources.title: Cameron Franc and Marc Masdeu, Computing fundamental domains for the Bruhat-Tits tree for GL2(Qp), p-adic automorphic forms, and the canonical embedding of Shimura curves
sources.use: Poisson moment evaluation and overconvergent computational framework over Qp. The corrected harmonicity/eigencondition matters. No unmodified transfer of its control theorem to the ramified degree-eight local field is asserted.

sources.title: Marc Masdeu and Eloi Torrents, Fundamental domains for quaternionic S-arithmetic groups over totally real fields
sources.use: General totally-real tree-domain algorithm requiring definite orders, integral local splittings and exact equivalence witnesses; identifies concrete inputs for the next bounded task.

sources.title: Eloitor/btquotients implementation repository
sources.use: Public README advertises general number-field input and Sage 10.9 testing. No pinned source review, installation, compatibility or runtime claim is made.

sources.title: SageMath, spaces of p-adic automorphic forms
sources.use: Distinguishes slow Riemann refinement from moment evaluation in the existing Qp implementation; not an evaluator for our ramified local field.

sources.title: John Voight and John Willis, Computing power series expansions of modular forms
sources.use: Assessment only: the numerical power-series method does not itself certify the saved differential bank. No new correctness theorem is attributed to this source.

local_sources.use: Completed multiplier, positive comparison and current absolute Hecke envelopes.
Arb integrand and analytic quadrature bounds, specialized at k=1.
Certified complex labels, with no inferred dyadic embedding matrix.
Actual definite algebra, 58 classes, dyadic residue degree one and ramification eight; exported matrix does not contain boundary transports.
Read-only inspection of the existing order/ideal interface. Its level-one SplittingMap is not asserted to be a dyadic integral splitting.

project_deductions: The mu=1 completed multiplier forces a lower floor for the specified whole-spectrum comparison; one required parameter suffices for rejection, not validation.
The global maximum h_p(1)=4*pi*(5-2*sqrt(6)) bounds all powers and their positive mixtures when the diagonal uses the unsigned geometric bound.
At the ramified quadratic CM point, three boundary charts have series-ratio valuations 1/2, 1 and 3/2.
Bounded measure moments give Taylor errors min((J-k)/2-d,P-(k+1)/2).
The coarse differential coordinate change cancels the factor two exactly and gives min((J+1)/2-d,P) for orders zero through two.
excluded_inferences: No lower bound on the actual omitted spectral sum, and no impossibility claim for Nelson's method.
No new full-spectrum upper bound or replacement of D98's existing enclosure.
No actual harmonic cocycle, moment bank, dyadic CM matching, Shimura jet or Gaussian chart.
No automatic reuse of inert-31 precision thresholds at the dyadic prime.
No candidate identification, target field polynomial, full tree census, new Hecke bank or cubic precision restart.
